title: Hash Brown
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 1 tsp

steps.instruction: Grate potatoes with the help of grater.
steps.romanUrdu: Aloo ko grater ki madad sa grate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add grated potatoes in ice cold water for 10 minutes then drain and squeeze out completely with the help of muslin cloth and set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Grated aloo ko thanday pani mein 10 minutes kliya dal dein phir drain ker ka malmal ka kapray mein dal ker mukammal squeeze ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add butter and let it melt,add grated & squeeze potatoes,mix well and cook on medium flame for 4-5 minutes & let it cool down.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein makhan dal ker melt karein aur grated & squeeze aloo dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur darmiyani ancch per 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein & thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add rice flour,red chili powder,salt,onion powder,black pepper powder,corn flour and cheddar cheese,mix well and let it rest for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab is mein chawal ka atta,lal mirch powder,namak,onion powder,kali mirch powder,corn flour aur cheddar cheese dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minutes kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: Grease your hands with oil,take a mixture and make oval shape of equal sizes.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur equal sizes ka oval shapes bana lein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,heat oil and fry until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein oil garam karein aur golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

ogDescription: Make the perfect restaurant quality Hash browns at home. #HappyCookingToYou
